clips.title: The story
paras: In the southern Barrens, Gann Stonespire seeks travelers to strike back at Bael Modan. The wandering tauren exile was driven from his clan’s ancestral home and hunting grounds, and asks you to slay the dig’s workers and bring him its leader’s journal.

Gann Stonespire walks alone along the southern road, seeking bloody restitution for his fallen kin. His clan’s ancestral birthplace and hunting grounds lay among the red bluffs south of the Barrens. Dwarves from Ironforge came to build Bael Modan, and drove the tauren out or killed them to make room for quarries and trenches. Gann says peaceful protests and diplomacy failed. Now he seeks vengeance for the clan that was displaced and slain.

At Bael Modan, dwarven excavators tear into the hills with steam engines and explosives. Prospector Khazgorm leads the dig deep into the earth. Gann asks you to thin the ranks of Bael'dun excavators and foremen, kill Khazgorm, and take the prospector’s personal excavation notes. He wants the notes to learn what the Alliance expedition seeks in the sacred soil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In solitude I wander these roads.

The dwarves of Bael Modan show no respect for my land. Horrendous blasts drive holes deep into the ground as noisy machines rip apart the hills. Lands which once served as home and provider to my tribe are now riddled with destructive dwarves.
Attempts at reaching a diplomatic resolution have failed. Now is the time for decisive action.
Drive the dwarves from the Bael Modan excavation by force and bring to me the journal of their leader, Prospector Khazgorm.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Many innocent tauren lost their lives or were forced off their ancestral birthplace when the dwarves of Bael Modan arrived. My land must be reclaimed!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Khazgorm met the fate he earned. I feel no remorse for the fool. He was an infidel on these lands.
May his death serve as a warning to all those who threaten to disrupt our way of life.
Now let me take a moment to study the dwarf's journal....
